notes:
AccountClient.inMemory(balance:contacts:failSends:) now keeps a Mutex-guarded balance. send lowers it and returns Payment(id: UUID(), ...). failSends throws SendError.declined with the balance unchanged. An amount above the balance throws SendError.insufficientFunds. The surface was already in the contract, so there is no surface commit. The gate was slice with --prove, as the prompt specified.
